acceptance.criterion: Distinguish Workspace, Project projection, Assistant, SessionKey, physical sessionId, native thread, Turn/Run/Task and resource owner without a second Project or task owner.
Give every lifecycle action a visible behavior, inheritance boundary, prerequisites, failure/unknown state, recovery path and current source entry.

Fix an isolated-agent negative matrix for active archive, duplicate/late completion, generation changes, backend switch, authorization revocation, cross-workspace and restart; leave unexecuted items unmeasured.
Pin candidate, inputs, metric definition and future acceptance budget; generate a fresh current receipt rather than reusing old PASS/sample evidence.
Generate a read-only session policy from TF-0512 owner-resolved current facts with scope/generation, backend/binding, model/effort, grant and bounded limits.
Keep configured, effective, unverified, unsupported and ignored facts separate; missing/stale/mismatched receipts remain unknown.
Report Codex native compact and Claude ownsNativeCompaction compatibility without creating another capability inventory.
Exclude credentials/auth values/private prompts and keep reads side-effect-free.
Reuse the existing activity/Recovery entry to show backend, effective values, sources, override/ignore reasons and truthful unknown states.
Distinguish abort from session stop, UI retention from transcript/resource TTL, and fork from worktree isolation.
Never show a prior session/backend/authorization/Gateway scope; older requests cannot overwrite the current selection.
Four locales, design tokens, keyboard/narrow coverage and a real built Electron Host/Gateway E2E are in the same change set.
A real Workspace, Assistant and SessionKey are bound to existing Task Ledger refs by the existing Workspace owner.
The binding can recover after UI close/app restart/handoff-like active session switch and is invalidated by reset/archive/delete.
Ordinary Chat does not enter long-session coordination automatically; visible entry remains C4.
Cross-workspace, missing-owner, revision-conflict and deleted-session cases fail closed; Task Ledger remains the only completion authority.
Use the existing session/role/orchestration path and bind coordinator generation, task ref, child identity, backend and tool grant in the receipt; accepted is not completion.
Do not reuse stale grants or allow child privilege escalation; unknown role/backend or refused spawn creates no phantom completion.
Use an actual isolation backend and serialize writes unless checkout/write-set safety is proven.
Handle duplicate submission, reset/stop races and same-owner restart retry without a second executor or infinite concurrency default.
Bounded accepted-worker batch; success/failure/cancellation all count; only a terminal batch can post one consolidated result.
Completion delivery is separate from task acceptance; busy/paused main keeps durable intent and does not steal the active user turn.
At-least-once transport cannot duplicate effects or cross reset/handoff generations because of receipt, idempotency and generation fencing.
Restart replay, refused/immediate workers, archive/delete/pause, active stop, independent batches and model-text-only cases have artifacts; final text alone is not delivery.
Open a stable main session through existing Sidebar/Chat and show task/worker/result references plus necessary pause/resume without a second task authority.
Represent draft, accepted, running, waiting, failed/cancelled, reported and accepted-by-task from actual receipts; locate worker transcript, Task Ledger and evidence sources.
Pass switching, minimize/restore, background work, keyboard, four languages, narrow layout and completion visibility in real Electron; preserve ordinary handoff/fork behavior.
Show real pause/delete/backend limits; stay quiet without new results; renderer uses only typed host-api.

acceptance.criterion: promotion gate: >=15% cost or input-token reduction, P95 within 1.10x baseline, zero safety regression; thresholds only movable by a pre-measurement proposal
acceptance.note: thresholds are validated inside the frozen workload hash; any edit invalidates the hash

acceptance.criterion: without authorized live provider or sufficient quality/cost samples, output evidenceInsufficient/NO-GO and complete decision inputs; never promote on simulated data
reuse the existing Cron/Workboard owner to persist an explicit schedule plus coordinator scope/intent (timezone, deadline, retry, missed-run handling, notification policy) without a new daemon
pause, cancel and stop-current-turn are distinct; archive/reset/delete/revoke cannot deliver into a new generation or trigger an unauthorized worker
restart/duplicate tick/offline recovery only runs currently-authorized, unexpired follow-ups; no replay of completed side effects; quiet unless there is a result
goal-wake and durable-helper keep their frozen default-off and mission scope; a plain session goal does not impersonate a durable mission
resources stay with existing owners; no universal session_resources table; unload/cancel/archive/delete are distinct
50 create/stop/archive-restore cycles leave zero managed residue; keep_on_leave terminals counted separately
cleanup failure/unknown raises recovery_required with retry identity; no agent-wide kill or other-worktree deletion
worktree/backend recoverability, browser grants, terminal closure and late callbacks cannot resurrect resources; permission revocation and workspace delete/switch/quit match owner contracts

at least six agent-driven real Electron/Host/Gateway journeys covering worker batch, background/UI closed, app and Gateway restart, fork/handoff/compact, revoke, archive/restore/delete and late events
at least two workspaces and one ordinary session act as isolation controls; cross-scope leaks, duplicate side effects and wrong completed/delivered claims are all 0
every journey reads back Task Ledger, transcript, owner receipts and resource state; an IPC-mock UI pass alone is not accepted as runtime wiring
OpenClaw and any available native backend are labelled with separate evidence levels; routes without real provider evidence stay fixture-only/unverified
freeze and run at least 333 sessions and long transcripts on the current candidate, recording load/switch/compaction/continuation P50/P95, actual bytes, summary calls/keys, long tasks and raw samples

a five-minute idle RSS curve plus at least 50 lifecycle rounds of owner/cache/listener counts are recomputable from disk; no unbounded growth and no scope-active residue; a missing explicit GC gate fails instead of being guessed
duplicate completion, no-change follow-up and hidden UI must not create duplicate notifications or background work; one meaningful result per batch; paused/expired queues stay bounded
regression budgets are fixed before measurement; untested platforms, live-provider and packaged scopes stay labelled unmeasured; a synthetic fixture is never claimed as real human long use
